title: Sun storms would take a month to hear
body: Sound cannot cross the vacuum between Sun and Earth, but even if it could at sea-level speed it would take roughly a month to arrive, and would spread and fade far below audibility on the way. Space silence is a distance-and-medium fact, not an absence of violence at the source. Explosions in films lie twice: in timing and in volume.
source_hint: Speed of sound vs Earth-Sun distance (calculation)
